messages:
elaine_cs: Heads-up — ACME (customer id: acme-42) opened a support ticket: they can't start the free trial because the UI insists on a card-on-file and the 3DS challenge never completes. They hit 'Authorize' and it just spins.

acme_onboarding: Yep. We try to authenticate, the 3DS popup shows 'challenge in progress' for several minutes, then we get 'authentication failed'. Tried twice with same card and a different user + incognito.

elaine_cs: Repro steps from customer: 1) Signup flow -> select free trial -> enter card -> click Pay -> 3DS modal appears -> spinner ~3-4 mins -> error. They attached a screenshot and network HAR (shared privately).

payments-bot: payment_intent.updated (pi_1HkXx9...) status: requires_action -> next_action.type: redirect_to_url; webhook attempt=2 status=500 -> will retry.

jordan_payments: Can you paste the payment_intent id and last4? Also which gateway? (Stripe or our fallback?)

elaine_cs: payment_intent: pi_1HkXx9aZ, card last4: 4242, gateway: stripe-us. Customer says gateway modal came up (bank 3DS) not Redwood-hosted iframe.

jordan_payments: Looking at logs — our callback from stripe timed out (we got 504 from /auth/3ds/callback) while the bank was still processing. Stripe retried but the client timed out on their side. There's a known flaky path when the iframe is routed through the bank's redirect and our webhook window is narrow.

ashley_billing: This flow can also be blocked by promo gating if promo code was applied earlier. If the promo requires card verification before granting trial credits we show card required. Did the user apply a promo code?

acme_onboarding: Yes, they entered promo code ACME-TRIAL-50 on signup. The UI accepted it but then asked for payment again.

elaine_cs: Summary: (a) 3DS auth hung then failed due to webhook timeout; (b) promo gating may require a successful payment intent to atomically grant trial credits. This creates a stuck state where card is required but 3DS failed.

jordan_payments: Short-term remediate: 1) Manually grant trial credits for account acme-42 (I'll run admin API). 2) Mark the payment_intent as "customer_action_required" so the UI shows retry instead of blocking. 3) Follow up with engineering on increasing callback window / idempotent handling.

jordan_payments: Admin command (internal) I will run:
```
curl -X POST "https://internal.redwood/api/admin/grant_trial" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"account_id":"acme-42","grant":"trial_14d","reason":"manual_escalation_1769996320"}'
```
I'll DM the result.

payments-bot: admin.action (grant_trial) queued by jordan_payments.

ashley_billing: I'll add a temporary exception to the promo engine so it doesn't block signup if 3DS is in a retry state. We'll record this as a known support playbook.

elaine_cs: Customer asked for guidance meanwhile — best we can tell them: try a different card or mobile network, or use a card that supports 3DS in a separate browser. Also we've queued a manual trial grant and will confirm when done.

jordan_payments: Done: granted trial_14d to acme-42; sent email to customer. Payment intent pi_1HkXx9aZ marked for retry. Logged GH issue: infra/payments#379 (increase webhook timeout + add retry-window).

acme_onboarding: Thanks, seeing the trial active now. We appreciate the manual fix. Please keep us posted about the root cause.

elaine_cs: Closing the loop here: manual grant completed, promo engine tweak in staging, engineering ticket with repro HAR attached. Follow-up owner: @jordan_payments. :white_check_mark:
